review_evidence: README identifies LeanPlot as a React/ProofWidgets plotting system rendered in the VS Code infoview.

A complete scan of the 76 primary Lean files found 365 declaration-style items; the five `example` declarations are demonstration/metaprogramming values (series specifications, labels and arrays), not mathematical propositions proved by the project.
The source implements plotting specifications, rendering, widgets, metaprogramming and demos, with no independent proved plotting semantics or mathematical theorem development.

source_action.content_invariant: All 76 primary files belong to visualization/widget/metaprogramming implementation and demonstrations.
